regression.before: AssertionError: project navigation must retain the history array (false !== true)
regression.after: passed; 10,000 retained messages, immutable streaming update, bounded persistence and pagehide flush
regression.runner_note: Core scripts/prove_regression.py only supports pytest and tests/ overlays; equivalent direct before/after Node test used for Interface.

installed_app.backup: Original application and user profile retained privately before replacement

native_evidence.observed: Upgraded app renders retained local workspace, saved manager conversation and connected local status
native_evidence.process_samples: Main and renderer predominantly idle in two-second samples; not evidence for all interaction workloads
native_evidence.limitation: Native automation reports noWindowsAvailable on coordinate input; keyboard did not produce a verified navigation. Full task journey and user acceptance remain unverified.

limitations: One-second scheduling delay for renderer-local snapshot saves; abrupt termination can lose changes in that window.
Git commands have a per-command five-second timeout, not a global deadline for all discovery.
No claim that every cause of reported freezing is fixed.
